no bottleneck attribution, so a decode-side memory-bandwidth benefit is projected onto compute-bound prefill and the end-to-end gain is overstated
calibration set is listed but not treated as a controlled variable, so single-draw variance and calibration-evaluation contamination are invisible
quality comparison is not decomposed into structured-output and tool-call conformance, where degradation is discrete and breaks machine consumers rather than mildly worsening prose
no percentile SLO framing, so a throughput gain purchased with a tail-latency regression is scored as an improvement
no cost formula, amortised qualification cost, confounder manifest diff, multi-GPU communication-share correction, soak monitoring or pre-registered decision rule
evidence_required: kernel-level profile on both arms mapping every hot layer shape to its dispatched kernel, with traffic-weighted fraction of GEMM time on the intended low-precision path and pinned engine/kernel-library/driver versions
per-phase roofline data (achieved bandwidth, FLOP rate, occupancy) for prefill and decode separately, plus the measured prefill-decode time split used to project end-to-end gain

at least three checkpoints built from disjoint calibration draws with identical recipe, reporting cross-draw spread of every headline metric, plus calibration-set hash and contamination check against the evaluation pool

full TTFT and inter-token-latency distributions at pre-registered percentiles with cross-run confidence intervals, at fixed SLO attainment, with queueing delay, batch-size distribution and preemption counts recorded
parser and schema validation over retained raw generations: exact-validity rate, violation taxonomy, tool-name and argument correctness, truncation rate, with and without constrained decoding

cost-per-million-output-tokens computation at fixed SLO attainment with stated formula, replica counts, fully loaded instance cost, and amortised build/calibration/qualification/re-qualification cost over a stated artefact lifetime

mechanically diffed complete arm manifests covering engine, kernel library, driver, hardware SKU and node identity, scheduler and batching settings, memory-utilisation fraction, decoding parameters and seeds

NCCL and kernel profiles at the deployed tensor-parallel degree showing GEMM versus collective time share, allreduce sizes and achieved bus bandwidth, plus quantization-group to shard-boundary alignment check

soak-period monitoring plan with duration, retained BF16 shadow or holdout, drift metrics, re-qualification trigger list, and a timestamped pre-registered decision rule with named independent reviewer and recorded deviations
